title: Top Makeup Primers for Smooth, Long-Lasting Makeup (2026)
summary: Milk Makeup Hydro Grip tops the list for all‑day wear, with Yves Saint Laurent, Charlotte Tilbury, Maybelline and e.l.f. offering strong alternatives for different skin needs.
method: Selected products mentioned in the provided sources, prioritizing those cited by more than one site (Milk Makeup).
assumptions: Prices are only included when a source lists them; otherwise the price field is null.

products.name: Milk Makeup Hydro Grip Hydrating Makeup Primer
why: Milk Makeup Hydro Grip is highlighted in both Marie Claire and EdytBeauty as a primer that locks makeup in place all day while providing hydration.
Its blend of hyaluronic acid and niacinamide offers a smooth, dewy finish that blurs pores and fine lines.
cons: May feel slightly dewy for oily skin
products.best_for: Anyone seeking a hydrating primer that stays put all day
products.skip_if: You prefer a matte finish or have very oily skin
products.amazon_listing: Milk Makeup Hydro Grip Primer with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide – Hydrating Face Primer G

products.name: Maybelline Grippy Serum Hydrating Makeup Primer with 2% Niacinamide
why: Maybelline Grippy Serum is highlighted in EdytBeauty for its affordable price and effective grip thanks to 2% niacinamide.
It provides a hydrating serum base that extends makeup wear.
cons: May feel slightly sticky on very dry skin
products.best_for: Budget‑conscious users who still want long‑lasting makeup
products.skip_if: You need a high‑end, luxury primer
products.amazon_listing: Maybelline Grippy Serum Primer, Hydrating Makeup Primer with 2% Niacinamide For Up To 24HR

products.name: e.l.f. Power Grip Primer + 4% Niacinamide, Gel-Based & Hydrating Face Primer
why: e.l.f. Power Grip is praised in EdytBeauty for its gel‑based texture that grips makeup and includes 4% niacinamide for added benefits.
It offers a lightweight, hydrating feel while keeping foundation in place.
cons: May feel slightly sticky on oily skin
products.best_for: Those who need a strong grip without heavy texture
products.skip_if: You prefer a matte finish or have very oily skin
